title: Insertion order of semantic maps changes capture stability

evidence.minimal_input: One CapturedNode; two equal flags and numbers maps with reversed insertion order. Same list, field values, driver ticks and response to scroll.
evidence.observed: Kotlin data equality true; fingerprints differ. Six fixed-order ticks request three scrolls; reordered maps request zero and record changing_content_no_actions.

impact: Valid equivalent driver frames can remain WAITING and avoid scroll/expansion; noise consumes capture time. Current Android TreeNode builds a fixed insertion order, so production occurrence on that adapter is not demonstrated. Defect confirmed in public core consumer, not claimed as observed phone incident.

alternatives.strategy: semantic canonical fingerprint for maps, preserving list order
enforce canonical map order at every producer
alternatives.status: partial producer workaround; core remains order-dependent

target_data_graph_object: CaptureFrame semantic observation; fingerprint is a derived identity, not a new graph storage requirement.
acceptance: CKP4-CAP-02B/03B PASS while CKP4-CAP-04 still PASS: reorder only object/map keys and preserve stability/actions; swapping node-list entries remains a changed observation.
migration_risk: Fingerprint values change. They are session-local, not persisted message IDs; do not reinterpret archived path strings as permanent identity. Never sort the node/message/action lists to get an easy PASS.
dependencies: B product owner adjusts existing fingerprint mechanism
device test if claiming actual Android capture occurrence

r42.exception: 2/4 allowed for SHA-256 and deterministic contract serialization
r42.reason: Changing hashing/serialization semantics changes the algorithm. The defect is treating data-map order as content, not the SHA-256 literal.

requirements.interpretation: Map insertion order is not a semantic change; asynchronous result still belongs to the initiating target.

title: Capture JSON omits effective settleMillis from recipe

evidence.observed: Both JSON documents are identical; options.settleMillis absent. Actual Android scheduler reads s.archive.options.settleMillis at UI line272.

impact: Exported observation lacks the interval used to decide whether two samples settled. Reproduction cannot recover the effective setting from this recipe; elapsed frame timestamps do not identify every attempted sampling interval. UI currently uses default700; host constructor accepts other validated values.

alternatives.strategy: include settleMillis with existing inline options
versioned resolvable capture-profile reference recording effective interval
alternatives.status: valid future contract; audit must bind real resolver if introduced

target_data_graph_object: Existing exported capture options/effective recipe and its version; no requirement to materialize all external source bytes.
acceptance: CKP4-CAP-05B exports effective1700. Vary only settleMillis: recipes remain distinguishable. If B replaces inline recipe with resolvable versioned reference, adapt test to that real reference consumer rather than accepting a truthy placeholder.
migration_risk: Old schemaVersion2 artifacts lack the field. Mark historical value unknown or inferred-from-version; do not fabricate a measured700. Additive field should preserve old-reader behavior, with explicit version policy.
dependencies: future importer policy for absent historical effective setting

r42.reason: Contract keys may stay in code; omitting the effective value is a provenance defect. This finding does not claim that moving one numeric literal repairs the path.

title: Existing target-binding finding also affects delayed paste success and failure fallback
status: still faulty; new consumer coverage, not duplicate finding

evidence.minimal_input: Suspend conversion after paste; switch editor A→B, or mark original editor sensitive; complete successfully or with failure.
evidence.observed: Success resolves current B and commits synthetic result through unchanged EditorController.commitText. Failure invokes pasteClip recording boundary for B. Sensitive change does not prevent commit. Unchanged-target control passes.

impact: Conversion completion can insert content into an unintended current recipient. Failure is also an operation: native fallback is not target-bound. This extends existing rewrite root cause; no actual provider call or OEM event was executed.

alternatives.strategy: operation ticket bound to target/revision/privacy; reject stale result with explicit state
retain result for user-confirmed application to current target
cancel on target change plus check ticket at completion
alternatives.status: valid composition; cancellation alone is not proof of no late callback

target_data_graph_object: Asynchronous operation record carrying source clip/revision, intended target/session, effective settings and completion/approval state.
acceptance: CKP4-PASTE-*-B PASS, CKP4-PASTE-STABLE remains PASS. Device gate subsequently confirms InputConnection/window identity on IME lifecycle. Caller must pass true operation identity; harness must not invent a product connection.
migration_risk: Pending operations need an explicit stale state and recoverable result. Do not silently reroute pending clipboard contents or reinterpret previous authorization.
dependencies: B shares target-bound primitive with runAiTask existing CKP-A-012

r42.reason: No policy default is excused; target identity is a runtime mechanism requirement. This is not a literal-removal finding.

title: Capture core keeps unknown facts and explicit partial/failure/private boundaries

evidence.observed: Unknown flag/number exported; private descendant and aggregate text suppressed; missing child carries unavailable_children; offscreen selection independent from visibleToUser flag; read failure retains prior observation with generic status and unverified completeness; clipping explicit; later producer-map mutation cannot edit stored observation.

impact: These tested mechanisms must survive repairs; do not convert unavailability into an empty successful complete capture. They are core host results, not evidence for Android OS permissions, document provider persistence or restart.

alternatives.strategy: current conservative redaction and explicit partial evidence
more complete capture via explicitly authorized adapter
alternatives.status: possible; does not erase partial evidence

target_data_graph_object: Existing frames/options/diagnostics exported by ConversationArchive; future graph mapping must retain epistemic distinction.
acceptance: Keep CKP4-CAP-06 through12 PASS when fixing fingerprint/export.
migration_risk: Do not drop unknown semantic facts or turn generic failure into complete=true.

r42.reason: These labels distinguish mechanism outcomes; generated human-readable UI text remains outside this exception. No blanket allowance for domain regex, thresholds or UI strings.
